region.name: The Dales
region.description: A custom region whose geography, history and cosmology will be expanded by the setting author.

settlements.name: Seabrook
settlements.notes: A busy mixed-ancestry port city whose trade outgrew its walls. Only scattered stone watchtowers and a crumbling keep protect the harbour; smuggling and cargo theft thrive in the unwalled dock wards.

important_sites.name: Old Rookhold
important_sites.description: The old keep on a headland has fallen into serious disrepair. Collapsed roofs, broken walls and flooded vaults make it unsuitable for defence. Residents whisper of something nesting below, but no one has verified what lives there.

settlements.name: Harrowford
settlements.notes: A small market town astride the old ford and ore road; a market meets twice a week around the trading post.

important_sites.name: Harrowford Adventurers' Guild
important_sites.notes: The party must report here as a contractual requirement.

important_sites.name: Bramwell Farm
important_sites.notes: One of two rival farming families.

important_sites.name: Kestrel Farm
important_sites.notes: The Bramwells' rivals in land and livestock.

important_sites.name: Hollis's Yard
important_sites.notes: Possible woodworks contracts, repairs and town investments as a future gold sink.

important_sites.name: The Shrine of Lethiel
important_sites.notes: Small local sanctuary dedicated to the goddess of life; healing and refuge may be offered at a cost.

important_sites.name: Vale Manor
important_sites.notes: Modest occupied manor house. The lord is self-serving and may be exploiting miners and farmers.

important_sites.name: The Stoneweight Trading Post
important_sites.notes: Ore brought from surrounding mines is weighed and sold. Twice-weekly markets draw farmers, miners and craftspeople.

people.name: Tavian Marr
people.notes: Commissions the party to investigate caravans vanishing in the Dales; requires an Adventurers' Guild report at Harrowford.

people.name: Mara Venn
people.notes: Has previously suffered raids; can disclose the goblin trail without a mandatory roll if tracking fails.

people.name: Lord Osric Vale
people.notes: Self-interested and politically compromised, but his actual crimes should be discovered in play.

people.name: Hesk, Roadwatch
people.notes: Can become an informant, ally or antagonist depending on survival and treatment. Not linked to the ruined coastal keep.
